title: Implement mergeTokenTrees() for tier stacking
description: Implement the token merge function that applies T1/T2 overrides to a T0 base while respecting protected token paths. Protected tokens (accessibility constraints) cannot be overridden. T2 overrides cannot modify T1-locked tokens. Respects $extensions.syncupsuite.protected flag.
acceptance_criteria: mergeTokenTrees(base, overrides, tier) exported from tokens package
Protected tokens (accessibility constraints) cannot be overridden at any tier
T2 overrides cannot modify T1-locked tokens
Comprehensive tests for override hierarchy, protection enforcement, edge cases
